root_text: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is circulating. 😷 Common cold-like symptoms, but can be serious in young children & the elderly. 🤧 Practice good hygiene: wash hands, cover coughs/sneezes, & consult a doctor if symptoms worsen. #HMPV #R
